_comment: LEVEL 4 (component): generic query-param filtering — search/range/sort/slice for list endpoints.
name: comp-search-filter
description: Generic list filtering from query params: search, range, sort, pagination slice. Import: from {{ utils_dir }}.filters import build_filters, apply_filters
notes: Usage: filters = build_filters(request.query_params, search_fields=['name']); items = apply_filters(query, filters, sort_fields=['created_at']). Converts ?search=, ?field__eq=, ?field__gt=, ?sort=field:asc into SQLAlchemy predicates. Works on any model with zero SQL.
